WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY rating
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_rate_per_day, ra.film_count,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day / b.overall_benchmark AS benchmark_ratio
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL
